title: Amazing guide!!
text: We had such a lovely tour with Marta. She was so lovely and you could really tell she was extremely passionate about what she was talking about. She gave so much information and was so attentive and engaging as well. We throughly enjoyed it!

title: Sagrada Familia small group tour
text: This was a great tour. Our guide Luis was very knowledgeable and entertaining. Of course, the church itself is absolutely stunning. We had a very small group so it was easy to navigate around and get a close look at everything our guide was describing. Highly recommended.

title: Awesome
